newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on quiet trade, Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on quiet trade, Tokyo.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday, as demand continued to evade the local market while Tokyo futures fell across the board, traders said.
Only one 300-tonne May consignment of SMR5 to Argentina was reported sold at 269 cents a kg, said an official trade source.
"It's been quiet on all fronts," said the source.

At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS Ones buyer and May SMR 20 buyer both down one cent each from Tuesday, at 276.50 cents ($1.10) and 260.50 cents, respectively.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 332 cents, SMR L at 310 cents, SMR 5 at 269, SMR 10 at 256 and drum latex at 228 cents.
Traders said prices were expected to fall further with the steady supply of latex after recent improvements in the weather.
